Maybe it’s the bite-sized gameplay that doesn’t demand hours of your day, yet still makes you feel like you’re building something. Or maybe it’s the quirky humor and fun little references tucked into the game that keep things feeling light and fun.

reviews.title: Nimblebit Fan
reviews.text: I am a fan of most of the Nimblebit games for the past ten years especially Pocket Trains.  I had never played this one before until this past week because I have been entertained plenty by the others. I am thoroughly hooked on Tiny Tower now. All the choices for floor type, little inhabitants, their costumes and their pets are so much fun. You can play in an easy frame of mind or enjoy figuring out all the strategies for more efficient game play. There are plenty of free supplies available with an option to turn on or off the ads for additional coins and bux. This game can be played with others or with yourself on a second device, gifting inhabitants to each other together with their costumes and pets. I totally recommend this game for relaxing and fun play whether for a few hours, a few minutes at a time or for a binge session. There are helpful tips in the Tiny Tower Wiki.

reviews.title: Best idle game of all time, no exaggeration
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game on and off since launch, this year I’ve played the longest consecutive playthrough I’ve had. It’s simply the best, no way around it. I’ve played many idle games and none compare. The art is great, the tasks are simple and it’s just one of those games you can get lost in playing while you do other things if you want. For example I play it a lot while I watch TV after work and need to just relax. The seasonal events are great too. The ability to roll dice or spin a wheel to get more bucks is also very surprisingly rewarding compared to other games who barely reward you. If you like 8 bit art and a good idle mobile game, this is the one for you, don’t hesitate. There’s a reason it’s been successful all these years. Kudos to the developers. Their other “bit” games are cool too but nothing will top this one!!!!!!

reviews.title: Very fun to pass the time
reviews.text: Tiny tower does what other mobile games do wrong. The gameplay is engaging and there’s much more to do than just build floors. You can customize your own wacky characters from a huge list of costumes and pets, complete quick but fun missions they give you (such as finding a misplaced bulldozer), and you can visit friends’ towers to give them a nice tip. Never once does this game force an ad upon you. There is an option to watch ads, and the rewards given are completely worth the thirty seconds if you’re up for it. Last but not least, the detail in the games unique pixelated style shows how much care was put into it, as each floor was created pixel by pixel. The enjoyment of seeing your unique tower grow filled with some rather questionable but funny floors (who puts a car dealership in a skyscraper?) will have players of any age constantly eager to make their tower bigger and better!

reviews.title: Free, fun, and addicting!
reviews.text: This really is the most perfect mobile game. The graphics are super cute, the writing on Bitbook and in the prompts are funny, and the concept is fun. Start your tower off with a little solid playing time, and then the game kind of plays itself in real time while you live your life. Check in and play for short times, you play for hours at a time- either way never gets boring. The best part is you can easily play without spending any real money ever unless you want to, and there’s no forced intrusive ads (you can choose to watch ads for coins or bux but it’s never mandatory). There’s no glitches, freezing, lag, or anything. Just smooth, continuous, free gameplay. Really, all mobile game developers should take notes because this is how phone games should be made. Love it so much.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text:
Honestly, I REALLY like this game. I love how you can earn Bux and Gold coins. You can also convert Bux to gold coins to build more stories for your tower. The addition of Bitzens and Bitbook is just lovely. I also like how you can hire Bitzens to work for your tower. Plus, the Bitzens even have individual looks and names! They also have dream jobs. Hire them in their dream job and make them happy. You also have VIPs that help your building and Bitzens. 

Well, the only thing I want to add on to the game is that you should be able to convert gold coins to Bux too. That would be more fair. Plus, Bux is really important as well. Other than that, good luck! I wish you all the best!

reviews.title: Where’s TT 2?
reviews.text: I’ve played this game off and on for about 5 or 6 years. I love the “bit” style animation and it’s a lot cleaner than other micro-managers. Definitely has a character of it’s own. Tried TT Vegas a few time, it just takes too long to get anywhere in that one. Tiny Death Star was brilliant, but I understand why it had to die (that darn Disney). Hope there’s a TT 2 or another in some other universe... maybe another sci-fi build or even a medieval theme (LOTR or Harry Potter?) The poll did ask about sorting so...? Just some ideas. NibleBit has been one of my fav devs over the years with classics like Pocket Frogs and Disco Zoo, none of which quite capture the magic of TT. Looking forward to something great from you.

reviews.title: Best game ever!!!!
reviews.text: Best game ever!!!! You can build your own tiny tower you can build more towers you can build a bunch of towers one for every season you can add shops you can add fun arcade you can add restaurants you can add you can add neighborhoods for people to live in people come visit there’s VIPs in the lobby that that can go up and make a dirty dream worker for a bit that lives there there’s a b***h but kind a like Instagram and you can post stuff and look at funny stuff that the the tiny people say that they see really fun things and then you can you can you can enter a raffle and you can make friends and yeah it’s really fun and I think you should get it too!!!!

reviews.title: Favorite game ever!! One suggestion
reviews.text: I first downloaded this game years ago when it first launched and I adored it! Downloaded it again 2 years ago and have been playing every day since. I have a VIP membership (which I highly recommend). It’s clear to see that the developers really care about this game and put so much time and effort into it. It’s fun building new floors and decorating my house. My only suggestion is that it costs waaaaaaaayy too much for new stories on the house. $40,000 should be changed to $10,000. My daily fireworks only gives me about 800 every day, and I’ve been playing for 2 years straight. That’s all!

reviews.title: So many ads that glitch out the game
reviews.text: I really like this game. HOWEVER, I can only give it three stars because it relies so heavily on ads. In order to progress your tower at a normal pace, you basically must watch ads. The problem is that a ton of the ads don’t load correctly. For example, I just opened the app, and it offered me double the coins I earned while I was offline if I watched an ad…I pressed “continue,” and the ad played for over a minute without ever giving the option to close it. I had to force quit the app, and I lost the reward even though I watched the advertisement for longer than necessary. This happens all the time!! I would give 5 stars for the game itself, but there are so many ads and a lot of them glitch!

reviews.title: Great time killer
reviews.text: This game doesn’t have a story, it’s not competitive, and there are no battles or online mode. But it is a very charming casual game. The atmosphere is calming, the music is nice and ties in with the game as elevator-type, the bitbook post are funny and always make me smile, and the game isn’t behind a huge paywall. The game in general is a nice product. You can tell that nimblebit really worked hard on this and this isn’t like an EA game were they only made it to make money. Even after a year of playing this game, it still never gets old with the constant updates. Overall, amazing game and I look forward to playing it for a long time.

reviews.title: Beware of addiction
reviews.text: I used to play this game as a kid, but I downloaded it again and it’s still super fun to play. No annoying invasive ads which is truly hard to find with App Store games. The graphics aren’t crazy so you can play it for a while at a time without your battery running out. The only thing missing for me is the ability to see more stats about your tower. I would love to have the option to see how many coins specific locations generate, how much I have spent restocking them, how much product I sell, etc. Even if it started as the option to view a report of all expenses and income for your tower for 24 hours that would be amazing.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I have been playing this game — experiencing this utterly masterful product — for nearly its entire history on the AppStore. It’s simple, yet addictive, engaging, interesting, and surprisingly deep. It brings me back to the games of old: where advertisements were respectfully placed and not splattered constantly on the player’s screen; additionally, the in-game currency is not exclusively derived from in-game purchases — all in-game currency is achievable if you are willing to devote the time and consistency. While few may read this one message caught amongst a sea of deserved positivity for this game, I hope those that do read it understand how dearly I hold this product and how certainly I recommend it.

reviews.title: LOVE THIS GAME!
reviews.text: This game has been one of my favorites since the very beginning! It’s cute and fun, and it’s easy to figure out. The basic concept is that you build up your tower with different floors. There’s shops and restaurants, and there are also residential floors that tiny people move into. There’s so many things to customize and manage, from stocking your floors to changing the names of your bitizens. It’s kinda one of those games you leave it alone to gain money, but I love how there’s still always something to do, like working the elevator for a few extra coins. I also love the cute graphics and antics of the little bitizens. This is such a cute game!!!! 10/10 would reccomend.

reviews.title: Love but Pls Fix Bug 😞
reviews.text: On the last quest of the tutorial, I'm supposed to upgrade my first  production building which I have done 4 times now. After the last quest I am prompted with a message letting me know I need to be 13 years old or older, however when I click continue the app crashes. After reloading the game, all my bux will disappear yet the shop I spent them on will not even have the first upgrade. On the 3rd and 4th time retrying, I worked my way up from 0 bux to 30 for the upgrade, yet it crashed and didn't save anything. I love this game so much, but I can't play it anymore because of this. The message regarding the terms of use and age limit is bugged. Please fix & I'll be sure to change to 5 stars. Thx. 💛

reviews.text:
Thank you for making this game. It is so wonderful and my family and I love to play Tiny Tower. But I do have a request.

reviews.title: Super Chill
reviews.text: I remember playing this game on my dads iPad when it was the first apple device my family had. My siblings and I begged him to get games on it and this is the one he compromised with. Ever since then I’ve played it on and off for 5 years and the most recent time I got it it had the golden tickets and I’ve been playing it ever since. Really something that doesn’t get old, the perfect game to play when you’re waiting for something. Waiting in line, waiting for food, traveling in a car. It doesn’t demand much of your time for it to be functional, but you can spend more time on it if you need to. Really can’t go wrong having this on your phone.

reviews.title: Love this game but after playing for years -
reviews.text: I’ve had my tiny tower since around the time that the app first came out. I have seen it’s ups and downs, deleted and redownloaded... I’ve seen it all! But I just feel that the app could start to do a little more to engage the users. Even something as simple as having the weather be different or involving the bitizens a little more. I love the game so much, but sometimes just restocking my floors gets a little mundane. In the past, I used to play a game called Sim Tower? I think? On the computer. Similar concept, but there were random missions which came up which needed to be solved right away or around Christmas time, Santa would come. Just little things like that would be so fun.

reviews.title: Bring back old content
reviews.text: I have been playing this game for at least 5 years now, and I really liked some of the stuff it used to have. For one, I really enjoyed the whole "Missions" thing (in which you had to get a certain amount of a certain product from a certain store), and how they were tied to a holiday. Along with that, I really liked how hard it was to get Bux, and in return, everything was cheaper. Another thing was that you used to be able to upgrade your model of the elevator (which also upgraded the speed of it), instead of buying a look for the lift and also having to buy the upgrade, separately. I still enjoy the game, but it just used to be so much better.

reviews.title: Favorite game
reviews.text: I love this game so much!! I’ve been playing for at least 3 or 4 years and I have to say as time goes by it constantly evolves into a better version of itself. Genuinely the only minor complaint I have is that there doesn’t seem to be a way to mute all ads within the game. I have all music and SFX turned off, I like listening to music and idly playing but I have to pause my music every time I go to watch an ad because the sound is always on and there’s no way to turn off all ad sounds. I wish there was an extra toggle for ad sounds ! Other than that one of my all time favorite games :)

reviews.title: Ads ads ads
reviews.text: Let me preface with saying I do really enjoy playing Tiny Tower. I love all the holiday events, costumes, and little pets. I also love getting to see what each floor turns out to be, and all the roof customizations. Normally, I have no problem with ads, like this game has a ton of them (and that’s fine), but when an ad takes me out of the game and opens my browser? That’s when I have a problem. There’s an ad in their rotation currently that does that, and there’s no way to stop it from opening a new tab on my browser. I don’t appreciate that at all, and their ‘Consent options’ menu never opens so there’s no way to opt out of this particular ad. Quite annoying.

reviews.title: Long Play Time
reviews.text: I have played this game on and off since 2012. It has changed quite a bit over this time, but it remains one of my go-to games because it is a simple game to learn, but it has a good balance of challenge and strategy that it is almost timeless. It can be as much of a time-waster as you want, or it can be a background game since the sells happen outside of you being in the game. I switch between these two playing styles often. I really enjoy having it and seeing my tower grow. I am very glad they added the ability to restart, too. It keeps the gane fresh and more of a challenge.

reviews.title: Great game!👍
reviews.text:
I’ve had tiny tower for a long time and play it on and off. And let me just say it’s great! It’s easy to come back to and let’s you have a feeling of power over an adorable tower filled with customizable bitzens (people), floors (to build to the highest of heights), and an upgradable lobby, roof and elevator to customize. You can also post on a fake “bitbook” and share jokes with them. They’ll share jokes with you too ! (not that they can actually read them) But you can also visit other towers and leave them tips. And they’ll do the same for you! 

So over all, tiny tower is a great game and is enjoyable to play whenever! I hope you give it a try!
👍😊😄🎧🎮👍✍️🏬

reviews.title: Poor attributes
reviews.text: I have had this game for years and have 222 floors. You can say I've loved this game. When the new update came out, I was thrilled. But I'm now disappointed. I don't mind that my next floor will cost me over 26 million coins or that gold bucks aren't available unless you start over (I definitely won't be starting over) but I HATE that the new residents don't have dream jobs in their strongest attribute category. I have used five realtors to move in five full floors of bitizens, but not one resident had a 9 rating in their dream job category. Why did NimbleBit change their attributes? I will never hire someone for the tailor if they only have a 2 ranking in that category. Please fix this, NimbleBit, or I'll stop playing tiny tower.

This game is unqie because it’s not much like an ordinary tycoon/business, this game needs you to stock things in order for you to make money, so this game needs you to come on at least twice a day in order to make money.

reviews.title: A Tale of Two Tiny Towers
reviews.text: It was the worst of thymes, it was the best of thymes. We cooked up a variety of floors, decor, costumes, and businesses. What makes Tiny Towers so great, is replay ability. You can change floor businesses, colors, themes, and workers costumes. You can either randomize or customize what kind of floor choices. Regular drawings give you a chance at Golden tickets that can improve living quarters or businesses. You can upgrade workers skills or evict them. You can upgrade floors and the elevator. Regular bonus dollars, coins, and quests gives incentive to play regularly. You can play a few minutes or hours depending on you schedule. My family loves the game and the flexibility.

reviews.title: Only game I play
reviews.text: I started playing tiny tower back in 2011 or 2012 and I loved it but had to delete so I could focus on school. Just the other day I had a random flashback so I downloaded it again (in 2018) my tower was still there and I have been enjoying it the past couple of days. Having been older now and more knowledgeable about app development I wanted to say bravo to these developers! I take notice of funny little jokes you guys have in the missions and certain jabs. I spent money on the app (something I never do) because I felt as though I am supporting some cool people with a real passion for developing. Thanks for the fun, even if it distracts me slightly. Great game!

reviews.title: Really really good game
reviews.text: I had this game for yearssss…They quit it and brought it back, I had a huge building at that point and lost it, so was mad and wasn’t going to play it again.  Could not help myself and started over, and still love it just as i did before.  It’s that classic game that when you buy a new device, its the first game to be downloaded, and also you have to have it on every single device you own.  Hope it last another 10+ years because it is sure worth it.  Only thing that needs to be changed, is they need to design one for PC, would love this on the laptop.

reviews.title: A shell of its former self
reviews.text:
I’ve played Tiny Tower for years across multiple devices and the game is fun of course but recently it’s become a joke. The sheer amount of offers the game forces on your screen is so annoying and makes the game borderline unplayable. The event boxes block the elevator, which prevents progress. The UI is so cluttered all the time and I love this game but can’t play it with so much UI clutter. 
But honestly the worst part is there is no way to bypass them, even if you spend money. Usually other games allow you to bypass ads by spending a small fee, but you can’t even do that in tiny tower. You’re simply stuck with the unplayable cluttered UI that straight up prevents progress.
All of this and more to say that if you haven’t already started, there is no point in picking up Tiny Tower, as you won’t be able to play it anyway.

reviews.title: One of my new favorite games!
reviews.text: I downloaded this somewhere in November and I just now decided to write a review, this game is absolutely amazing and fun for people who like calm and laid down games! The pixel art has a fine touch to it and gives the game a cute little vibe! The new 3 hour free gifts are a good addition to the game! I’m only confused about why the VIP package is super expensive. It does look great to buy but I don’t think I want to buy it since it’s very expensive. Developers, if you are reading this can you please explain to me why the package is expensive? Sorry if the way I worded this seemed a bit snotty. But anyways, the game is awesome and i recommend people to download <333 :D

reviews.title: Love this game! Bugs can be an issue though.
reviews.text:
I’ve re-downloaded this game more times than I can remember. I’ve always enjoyed it.

Recently, however, anytime there is new content added to the game, I have to wait until they release another update to fix the bugs. It’s kind of ridiculous. It makes it so I can’t play the game for upwards of a week every time. It freezes when it tries to load the game and nothing happens when I touch the screen. This is the third time it’s happened and I’m only now reviewing to ask tiny tower folks to make it playable when the new stuff comes out… not a full week after because of bugs.

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text:
I don’t play many mobile games for more than a week or two before I lose interest but this game does not apply to that rule. This game has kept my interest every day since I downloaded it. 

Great game for “spur of the moment” gaming opportunities. Have a minute or two to wait for something? Pull your phone out and stock your tiny tower floors quick. Make sure you enter the raffle! 

This is a great game that doesn’t require a lot of attention or time. There’s plenty to do while you wait for tasks to complete and if not, you can easily spend your hard earned “bux” to speed up progress. You can pop in and out of this app throughout your busy day whenever you get that quick minute or two to kill and you will make decent progress. 

The only drawback to this game is that progress is painfully slow without the VIP upgrade, but I honestly see myself playing this game for quite some time so $2

reviews.title: not perfect, but great
reviews.text:
tiny tower is a fun, addictive game. i’ve been playing for years. the graphics are super cute, the concept is rather unique, and it’s easy to pick up and put down. i agree with many others on the restock time being much too fast; i hate being “that person” who compulsively checks their phone so my tower suffers a lot of dead time. 
the progression can get frustratingly steep after playing for a while. the incremental prices of building new floors and the ratio between coins and bux gets pretty high. the ad thing is cool and it’s easy to earn bux, but you start to plateau if you don’t pay up. it kinda makes the whole thing slow-going, which is made worse by the fast restock times. just some thoughts. 
side note, as others have said, i took a lengthy hiatus and got a new device and lost all of my progress, though my achievements still exist in game center. i didn’t much mind starting over

reviews.title: Excellent game in every way
reviews.text:
Truly a perfect mobile game.  No other way to put it.  They give you so much premium credit that you rarely feel starved after you get going for a few days.  They give you, in various neat ways, a lot of premium currency for quickly checking in once or twice a day.  And it scales very well if you are playing to any degree more frequent then this.  It scales decently if you play less then once a day.  I play in spurts of varing lengths over the past 3 years.  The mechanics of evolving or transitioning to a clean slate, either after a period of inactivity or as part of the normal game progress, is extremely well done!
2/10 ;)

reviews.title: Rare game on the App Store that’s actually FUN!
reviews.text:
It’s so hard these days to find quality games that don’t overwhelm you with ads or without overly annoying/borderline harassing notifications, but this app gives me more hope that the future of mobile gaming isn’t doomed! 

It’s a wonderful game and upgrading actually feels achievable! I don’t feel like I'm forced to watch a million ads for little in return or if I click the screen two times I'm suddenly met with five ads. It feels very balanced and they offer so many different rewards if *you decide* to watch ads! Nothing is forced and I love that :)

reviews.title: This Has Been My Favorite Mobile Game Developer Since I was Little
reviews.text: I remember when I was 9 and got my first IPod, so I could text my mom, and play games. I really loved pixel games at the time, and couldn’t find any as good as NimbleBitLLC’s games. I got my tower to level 25 (which to me back then was pretty impressive) and had found out they made other amazing games! Like Disco Zoo, Nimble Quest (which I’m not sure is still up) and Pocket Trains. Now that I’m a little older, I’m having so much fun seeing that LEGO Tower is soon to be released! One of my favorite toy companies ever! And I think the world’s best selling toy at the present. So NimbleBitLLC, you have such potential! And keep on climbing! ;)

reviews.title: Love the game, very nostalgic
reviews.text: I used to play this game 5 maybe 6 years ago, I’m not sure it’s been a minute lol. But I still love this game and I think I’m even more into it now than I was then. Definitely one of my favorite mobile games growing up and still is. Glad to see it’s still running and is stable enough to run on its own without shoving ads down your throat(unless you want them, then it’s usually only when you choose to watch them for in-game rewards do you have too) but yeah game still seems fresh and up to date and I’m pretty happy to be with the Tiny family again!

reviews.title: One Of The Greatest Games On Mobile!
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing this game for many years and I’m happy to say that it just gets better as you play more! I’ve never had an issue with anything in the game other than occasional ads, but they aren’t forced and are optional if you want additional rewards.

I finally found the time to sit down and write a review on this game because I’m always busy, but I can say that usually when I sit down, this is the game I play. I highly recommend everyone to try it! It’s been out a long time and in my opinion is one of the best mobile games out there!

reviews.title: This game is a true work of art
reviews.text:
Over the years I’ve been playing mobile games, I’ve seen many companies get greedy and add paywalls and such to their games, but not nimble bit, they’ve remained true through and through. Two things I’d like to see added
1. When a bitizen goes to an apt. floor when it’s full, you should get the option to evict one resident to put the new one in if you want, or leave it be.

2. this one I don’t really care about, but in pocket trains there is a fluctuating bux to coins rate daily, which I think is very good, and I think it’d be cool to see that in tiny tower as well.

reviews.title: Love this game and let it have your soul
reviews.text: I have been playing this game for about 2 years on and off. It’s the best game I’ve just never found the heart to get rid of. It fills that void of timeless boredom you don’t want. It’s the perfect game to always come back to. I enjoy building this tower, decorating the rooms paint, and giving it a new name with a spin on it. It’s enjoyable, fun, time passing, and worth it for free. It’s a game you’ll always find yourself coming back to and for a few days every time you do you’ll be addicted. You even get to put costumes on your bitzens. It’s fun and I love it and you’ll love it to so you should play it and have it melt into your heart.

reviews.title: Amazing! Reminds me of a childhood game.
reviews.text: When i was younger, I played a game called Small Street. It was addicting, and similar to this one because you have different shops and would hire people, except you had no houses just people got jobs. You would use the taxi to transport people to place to place and could expand the shops and upgrade. One day though it went off the App Store and I was devastated. This app brings a lot of memories back even from when I played Small Street, and I’ve only had it a day. It’s addicting and fun and I’ve never cried soo much into finding a game like this. Thank you.

reviews.title: Great Game, however, inflation
reviews.text: I love this game, it’s a lot of fun. However, and this is a huge pet peeve of mine, purchasing a house (one of the new features) is ridiculously expensive. I’ve been grinding bux for over a year to get the second floor to my house, and I just realized that even if you drop 100 real life bucks into this app, you still wouldn’t have enough bux to build a second floor of your house. To me that’s ridiculous, and if the developers do happen to come across this review, please adjust the prices, houses do absolutely nothing anyways, so houses being over 100 real dollars is a huge scam.

reviews.title: Great Game 1 suggestion

You guys did a great job with this game and if I could give you guys 10 stars I would. Sorry for the run on sentences.

reviews.title: Pretty Good
reviews.text: I love this company. Theyve made some of the most iconic mobile games ive ever played. I literally remember starting pocket frogs on an old ipod touch. But thats whats so great about their games; theyre timeless! Tiny tower is entertaining and captivating enough that i make sure to check in at least once a day on my tower. From the reviews left by renters to the challenges you get every few minutes, it will definitely keep your attention for at least 10 mins whenever u remember it, in my case, everyday lol

reviews.text: I played this game for ten years now. Haha, I love this game so much, I also suggest pocket frogs by nimblebit. Thanks for reading. :P

reviews.title: This is literally one of the best games I’ve downloaded
reviews.text: Ok so this is my first review on any game ever but I got to hand it to the developers. The game is a fun FREE game that doesn’t require needing to purchase anything, while still giving the option to support the makers of the game. While it’s not a game that u would play for 30 mins at a time, it’s one of those games which you admire as the game progresses. Though it’s slow at first, once u start making money, it just keeps on going and it brainwashes you to continually check to restock your floors. Hands down one of my favorite games ever. Thanks to all of those who made this game possible!!

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I really love this app. But I’m at the end of the rope. Can you please add Floors our jobs for the citizens. Can you please allow us to spend our coins on some thing. I’m on the billions and nothing to spend it on. Maybe give us the opportunity to convert the coins into bux? The bonus or reward game you had for the summer was not very clear. No instructions nothing. Did not know how to finish the rewards, did not even get halfway. Can you please bring that back but with better instructions.? I want to keep playing this game but You don’t have any more goals to complete.

reviews.title: Miss the old game !!!
reviews.text: This game is amazing. Definitely the most enjoyable idle game I’ve played. The game has enough moving pieces to keep it from being stale. However, in recent years this game has become too complex. The addition of the plane, the house, all of the squares on the left hand side (most of which I don’t understand at all), and the gimmicks to get you to pay for bux/coins has made this game too messy. I completely understand the developers need to put food on the table, but this game is too much. I still manage my tower as close as I can to the original, but it’s too much. I love this game, it is very well executed, but the older versions were much much better. Please go back NimbleBit !!!!!!

reviews.title: Simply Successful
reviews.text: What can I say? The game is simple if you like a little bit of simulation, idle gameplay, and pixel art. There’s just enough to do to keep you entertained without complicating the simplicity tiny tower inherently relies on. There’s just enough customization to sorta make it personable or themed—a mechanism that boosts replay value. I’m on my second tower but I already have an idea of what my third tower is going to be. reviews.title: Awesome game!! But...

reviews.title: A TYCOON GAME DONE RIGHT
reviews.text: To start I’ve had this game on every phone I’ve had all the way back to my iPod touch from 2012. My favorite part about this game is that you really don’t need to pay for anything, and not in the way that you need to pay for non essential stuff. reviews.title: Bring back coins/minute!

My iPhone Apps are set to automatic upgrade and when I opened my game yesterday I was shocked and dismayed. The screen was “zoomed in” and I couldn’t see coins/minute anymore. This component wasn’t moved to another section of the game. It’s just gone!

I use this statistic to calculate how much time before I am able to purchase a new floor so I can plan my game time accordingly. Please bring it back!

I appreciate wanting to make the game full screen but not at the expense of the g

reviews.title: Too invasive with ads
reviews.text: I've been playing Tiny Tower since the iPod Touch and overall I love this game. It's the only game I actually open and play usually on a daily or weekly basis depending on how busy I am but lately when I'm playing I have a bitizen on a parachute come down and offer me to watch ads almost every minute or so and it's really annoying because I have to say no every time and I have video offers turned off in settings. I even have VIP on my tower but I still get bombarded with video offers. It no longer feels very VIP. Please make the advertisement offers less intrusive at minimum please. Thank you.

reviews.title: Great Until Recently
reviews.text: Charming graphs, easy to figure out, and honestly relaxing. I usually give kudos to this game due how much easier it is to get the more special currency than being pressured fo purchase it with real life currency. However, I’ve stepped back from that a bit recently. More and more the ads I choose to view to get “bucks” are harder to mute, longer and require tapping the close button multiple times, sometimes seemingly not even registering as a real close button and one that just brings up the ad’s App Store page. Very frustrating. Still overall very good. Please fix this issue though.

reviews.title: Tower tycoon!
reviews.text:
Fun, building, managing and customizing style game like those old school tycoon style games we used to play. Plenty of options to customize your tower as you build it and convenient automatic features that make restocking and other features easy to use. 

My only con is I wish there was a better system in place to view current shops and people with dream jobs together. It’s a bit tedious getting bitizens to their dream jobs. You have to view bitizens, see their dream jobs and search to see if you have that shop, which becomes difficult if you have 100+ floors. 

Nonetheless it’s a fun game to play for a short amount of time or longer. Love my tiny tower!

reviews.title: possible future features?

reviews.title: Was a great game, now it’s way too pay to win.

reviews.title: Really good!!! I miss somethings, though

reviews.title: Really good and fair
reviews.text:

reviews.title: Good, but could be better
reviews.text:

Having the menu and ‘X’ button on the extreme bottom right of the screen really hurts my right thumb to press. The characters are too small, and the missions to find specific things or people on the floors is really bad. I have to hold my phone three inches from my face to see anything, and it gives me a headache. 

I love this game, but it DESPERATELY needs more accessibility options in the settings. 

I would love to zoom in on my tower with a slider to see better. 

I would love to be able to move buttons around to where they are comfortable to reach. 

I would love the pixel art to have a white surrounding ‘border’ option, to help the characters stand out against the backgrounds.

Please add more settings to customize our individual preferences! Something like that would go a long way

reviews.title: The OG of tycoon games

reviews.title: Best Idle Game Out There!

reviews.title: Nostalgic and not too demanding

This game is perfect for those who are working as there is no need to be playing for more than a couple minutes a few times a day once you progress a little bit.

reviews.title: Great Game!

I redownloaded this game in may to see if i would enjoy it again and i LOVE IT! this game is so easy to play and i love the fact that i don’t ever feel like i’m running out of money. everyday you collect rent from your apartments and businesses and you get a daily cash reward. i never have felt the need to buy more of the games currency to keep the game going. this game is very fun to check up on throughout the day

reviews.title: best game ever

Recently I decided to download it. reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: 325 floors. That is how much I used to play this game. At least the old format. Then they decided to change the odds in their so you have to pay to get ahead. reviews.title: So Much Fun!!!
reviews.text: Bit Tower is such a great mobile game to play. It has everything you could want in a tower. It’s such a fun game. I love this game because you can play it in your free time and over the time you play unlock stuff your friends don’t have. I love this game but I have one suggestion. Make it so you can change your apartment guests skin color. I really think overall if you can change the skin color of the hotel manager then you could with the guests as well. I’m just saying but overall I love this game. Thank you so much for making it and good luck for future games you make.😉~❤️

reviews.title: loved this game for years
reviews.text: i used to play this back in high school. after switching devices over the years i downloaded the game again about two years ago and that update was absolute trash. i'm very glad that they went back to their original style. and not only that, but you can also post on their little bit book & it's a lot easier to obtain bux (be lucky you don't have to understand the struggle if you're a new player lol) some may complain that it gets boring when everything gets more expensive, but that's what motivates me to keep playing honestly. my only complaint is that you used to be able to buy any costume you wanted and now you have to wait for someone to come in the elevator with a random costume to obtain it. it's super lame because when i get someone their dream job i want to put them in an appropriate costume. but oh well i guess it'll come with time. great game overall, i recommend it to anybody.

reviews.title: Fun way to spend small amounts of time!
reviews.text:
Tiny Tower allows you to progress at your own pace. If you want to spend hours building your tower taller and getting golden tickets, you can do that! If you just want to complete the daily and weekly challenges for dice rolls, you can do that! If you don’t want to watch ads, there are no mandatory ads, just ones that allow for some small benefits! 

I played this game in the early 2010s and came back almost a year ago, and while it isn’t the same, I still really enjoy it!

reviews.title: Unsure yet
reviews.text: Please make more rewards for playing and sending people on the elevator more than it is. I’m deleting but I’m  someone who saves their money so if I do in app purchases I don’t have to think about it. Covet collection is a good example of money with fair in-game rewards and something I play consistently. Each person I updated with Bux, it didn’t show. The money I purchased for bux is on me. Idk, I just wished it was more obvious when I spent my money, what I get. On top of that I’d like more bundles to buy. I’d pay actual money for the dream work VIP, and having more rewards and opportunities to update rooms would be great. Again. I’ve spent money, but unlike some other apps (ex, covet collection, anything NYT, BitLife, etc..)

reviews.title: Fantastic time passer
reviews.text: This game is quite entertaining the more you play it, it has fun features that make you laugh like the Bit Book, where your residents post funny things about their job or neighbors. The game doesn’t force the idea that you have to constantly be on it to do anything. You get the creativity of painting your apartments and restraints another color and you get a random themed floor every time you build one, what’s not to love about playing the guessing game, the VIP feature is really neat, costly but worth the support of the developers. I appreciate the hard work!

reviews.title: Tiny tower awesome tower!
reviews.text:
This game is literally my favorite game...well...EVER! I L-O-V-E LOVE it! Long lasting fun for All ages! I think more people should play, frankly. If you are thinking of getting this game and you are like:

reviews.title: Tiny Tower Is Awsome

At the start it is only 5,000 bucks to build a new floor trust me that isn’t a lot.  Also you can give your ais a costume, how funny is that! reviews.title: Love the game! Hate the things that they add.
reviews.text: Love this game! It is random yet addicting. However I do not like when they add things that cover the elevator. Like the ice cream challenge icons. I have literally not been able to tap the icon for my rent coins for 2 weeks because it is hidden behind the ice cream icon. And yes I have tried everything possible but it is impossible. I will be glad when the ice cream challenge is over !!!!!!!! (: I also think you guys should focus on keeping it authentic to when it first came out. There is no need to add all of these random challenges that make no sense and just hinder the seamless gameplay experience. Thank you!

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.text: you get soooo addicted to this game as soon as you start playing. i love the whole idea of this game and it’s just the best. i love that it gives you bux and it’s easy to get coins. the bitbook is entertaining and the daily rent and fireworks are such an advantage in the game. but there is one thing the amount of bux you can trade in for coins is way to expensive. it takes awhile to earn 2,000 bux to get coins then save up more than that. also there needs to be more options to get coins with bux. the numbers get really high after the second option for the bux-coin exchange.

reviews.title: AMSR for Idle Games
reviews.text:
I played this game way back when it was first released and enjoyed it thoroughly. I had every floor maxed out with perfect bits on ever floor. I played some of the other TT games that iterated on the original (Star Wars, Vegas, etc), but never got hooked as much as the original.  

I took a break for a few years and happily jumped back in a couple months ago. The updates have drawn me back in and I’m really enjoying the play again. Friends, gold tickets, and new floors are great!  Thanks Nimblebit and I’m always looking forward to your next game!

reviews.title: Fun at 1st but not as fun later! Overall it is fun!
reviews.text: This game is so addicting! It is so much fun, but after awhile it gets boring and u won't play it much! It gets boring b/c all u do is watch people come thru and take them up out of the elevator! But also u can build stuff if u have the coins!  So there is some pros and cons! But overall it is a great game! Now I don't play it much b/c it isn't fun anymore but at the beginning in is fun! Enjoy it while it last! U will love it at 1st and then u will hate it!  But maybe not! It is worth purchasing though! Have Fun!!!! :) U might not hate it though that might just b me!

reviews.title: Great Game!!!
reviews.text: Tiny Towers is a wonderful game for anyone of any age! I would rate this is a 5-Star game because it is very fun and simple! Yes, it may be frustrating not having enough coins for a new floor or enough bux for an elevator upgrade, but it's worth waiting for! Everyday you get on, you get a fireworks display and you get more and more bux every time! If you miss a day, don't worry, it continues from the number you were at! You can name your bitizens, rename and paint your floors, and get awesome VIP's to use in your tower! Tiny Towers is a spectacular game that I would definitely recommend trying out!!!

reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.text: I originally downloaded this game several years ago, bought a new phone and never redownloaded it. Not too long ago I was surfing through the App Store and ran across Tiny Tower. I forgot how much I enjoyed it. There’s not much too the game. Floors of businesses and apartments are added over time. Being able to remodel individual floors and add themes to the roof, like Disco Zoo!, are a nice touch. Dressing the Bitizens in quirky costumes is a plus. I especially enjoy reading the posts made by the residents onto their social media platform Bitbook, it’s definitely good for laughs. Accumulating coins and bux quickly without having to invest your own money is great.

reviews.title: It's great! Just a few things to think about...
reviews.text: This game is amazing! But it is not luxury. If this game cost money, it would not be worth it but I think it is still fun and addicting. In the game there are small little boxes that pop up on the bottom corner of the screen to tell you when ur shipment has arrived, and other cool things. There is a box that pops up to give u free money (the money is fake money) if u watched a video. That box pops up all the time and is kind of getting a bit annoying. If you made pop up maybe eight times a day that would be great.

reviews.text: I had SO MUCH FUN playing the game when I was on a cruise last spring break (this was March 2016) Because the sushi bar cheat made the game SO MUCH MORE FUN! reviews.title: My favorite game!!!
reviews.text: I’ve played this game since it was first put on the App Store. I love that you don’t have to spend actual money to enjoy it, however I do spend a bit here and there to support the programmers that made such an enjoyable game. Love the bit book comments! Wish there was other ways to earn golden bux besides starting my tower again. I’ve been working on it for 7 years....it would be pretty cool to have more than one tower in your control at the same time once you reach a certain level. Thanks for the endless hours of enjoyment! 💗

reviews.title: Needs A Major Update
reviews.text: I love this game. I’ve been playing this game since i was a little kid in elementary school. I recently redownloaded it and i’ve been hooked. Same good game and all but, it feels the exact same. I feel personally that this game deserves a major update. Maybe a sequel, art design anything. While playing, sometimes things feel bland. Although, monuments and airport shipping does feel refreshing, the game would be a lot better if it had new graphics (like the cover art), some sort of gameplay mechanic involving your character, and generally just more fun less grind

reviews.title: Oh... dear God
reviews.text:
Let’s start off with the good. The game itself is amazing. The 8-bit style is fun and the gameplay itself is smooth and clear. But this game isn’t free. When you get to higher floors, the cost can be upward of 14 million dollars, and for me that can take over a month. I tired the vip and was hooked. I loved it and I could buy another floor daily. I went to buy the pass...
And it’s 20 freaking dollars.
I don’t care what you’re selling. If it’s on the AppStore and says free, then why does it cost 20 dollars to proceed in the game?
If you lower the price- maybe even to ten I’ll buy it. But if you’re looking for a game that you want to feel satisfied about your progress, this isn’t for you.

reviews.title: Nostalgic and fun!
reviews.text: This game is one I grew up with on my iPod touch a few years back. I’m an adult now, and I saw that this game was still on the App Store, so I figured I should check it out. To my surprise, it’s just as fun as it was then! It’s still totally playable without in-app purchases, although they are nice if you feel like supporting the game and getting a little boost. All in all, I was impressed with how this game resisted the temptation to become pay-to-win, and I play it whenever I have a quiet moment in a doctor’s office or a car trip!

reviews.title: There’s a reason it’s editors choice…
reviews.text:
This game is so much fun. It isn’t intense, competitive, or difficult. It’s just a fun, easy, idle game to play and grow on. You get to build your own hotel/tower and customize it to your liking while having bitizens move in and run the restaurants and live in the apartment rooms. It’s simple and easy to learn but very fun to play in your free time when you just need a break. I just recently started playing it and I am already addicted to it. And you want to know the best part? No ads!!! 

  5 stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: Amazing game, brings nostalgia...
reviews.text:
I would like to say that this mobile application is an amazing game. It is just a calming experience really.  Although, it definitely is not as good as Tiny Death Star, which I wlil always remember, but this game still brings me nostalgia from that other classic.

Tiny Tower starts off with a tutorial, helping you build new levels and learn the mechanics of the game.  From there, you are on your own in this amazing pixelated video game.  The people who made this game are geniuses and NimbleBit has been continuously one of my favorite mobile application developers.

reviews.title: Old version
reviews.text: I have been playing this game for years....maybe over a decade lol. And I have to say overall I love it. Super cool. BUT I really miss some of the old features like the ‘challenges’ where you would have to collect so many items from different stores and then you’d get bucks. I also really liked the stats feature...I know it tells you how many coins you make a minute by your bank total, but I liked seeing how many floors of each category you have. Would love to see these features come back. Especially the challenges bc they’re not a ton more to do in the game besides stock floors.

reviews.title: Fun but addictive
reviews.text: This game has been an addicting game for me, and also my cousins. They love it and so do I! We like the features that we can give bitzens to each other. Keep up the good work!!! But maybe  the developers should make it so you have a better chance of winning a golden ticket. Also I Like the new update where your piggy bank fills up and you can empty it with money. Lastly you should be able to Buy Golden tickets for A Certain amount of Bux instead of it being sorta like a lottery. Thanks to the Developers of this game my Bits are happy in my own tower.

reviews.title: Still great!
reviews.text:
I first played this around 8 or so years ago, and I’ve forgotten how fun this game is! Compared to a lot of other apps nowadays, this game is actually pretty generous with giving out Bux/Coins. The piggy bank, too! It’s very easy to progress in this game, and I love the variety in customization.

You can easily play the game without spending a dime, but I’m considering getting the VIP just to support the devs. It’s a simple, but very entertaining game that doesn’t rely on microtransaction after microtransaction, which I wholeheartedly appreciate. 

Cheers!

reviews.title: Yes.
reviews.text:
Of all the 'fidgety', 'check-back in', 'short time waster' mobile games, this is hands down the best one I've ever put money to. The graphics have always been satisfying, the customization has always been enjoyable, the need to push for that next resident floor to use my lobby full of Real Estate Agents 😅, the list goes on. 
I 100% recommend getting the VIP package purchase if you have the means to ; just the auto elevator, complete roof-lobby-elevator customization, and the quicker intake of Bux definitely sold me and continue to make me not regret choosing to get it.

reviews.title: Been playing since high school
reviews.text: This game came out on iPod touch when I was a kid and I played it a lot but deleted it cause I was to busy for games. Now I’m not to busy so I play it and I had to start over but it’s okay I tried the 5 day VIP and it gave me a big boost and the game is fun. The more towers I build the harder it is to find these people but thanks to costumes they stick out like a sore thumb. I suggest organizing the floors in Alphabetical order and separate them from the living spaces. That’s what I do to find stores that need to be fully stocked up so I can earn 10 buck.

reviews.title: The best game since... well ever!
reviews.text: As you notice people have been complaining ‘bout golden tickets! Not me. (.,’/:;”) those icons cannot be texted in bit book. Plz update it so they can. Can you plz make the upgrade prices (a bit) lower. I am in the range of 1,300-1,400 bux. I am going for the Infini lift lightspeed elevator and that costs 2,500. Here are the things that are amazing about this app so far: Not to many ads ( unless you choose for 20 bux ), the little 8 bit people act so well, good gameplay, and so much to work with and stuff! I promise you are doing great!!👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 KEEP UP GOOD WORK!!

reviews.title: Cool idle game
reviews.text: This is a fun little thing to work on a few times a day. It’s like an ant farm, but you have little people living and working on different floors of your tower. It’s fun to see what random types of businesses and apartments pop up when they’re finished, and if you don’t want to watch ads, you don’t have to, but they make it worthwhile by giving you bux to keep your businesses stocked. And you can customize your bitizens with outfits you unlock over time. I first played this years ago, and coming back to it now, it’s still great.

reviews.title: Not worth revisiting, even for nostalgia
reviews.text:
The game has been bloated with ads and in game purchases that it’s now impossible to just ignore them. The ai generated icon is evidence enough that the original devs are either gone or just don’t care anymore.

They are trying to force you to play the game constantly and spend money when the game was meant to be played for a couple minutes at a time, it’s obvious they don’t care about the user experience anymore and are just trying to make money.

Extremely disappointing considering this game is a classic, and is now completely ruined. Instead of making a sequel they decided to just ruin this game, so now you don’t even have a choice to go back and play the game like how it used to be.

reviews.title: Really well made but need more to do
reviews.text:
Love the game but i wish there were more interactive things to do. For instance, pairing couples (and being able to watch their romance grow via bitbook statuses), feeding pets, more complicated searching missions like scavenger hunts, etc. 
Also, achievements for costume or pet collecting (like arrange them in sets and give rewards for every set that is completed), or for number of floors or number of total objects found/people delivered, total number of VIPs used, number of bitizens employed at their dream jobs… i think that would add a little more incentive to the game

reviews.title: It’s great
reviews.text: My favorite part about this app is that it gives you feedback on what the people think like it’s kind a like Facebook but not really. I think it would be cool the creators made another one but with the post they can let us do pictures of our characters. But there’s something weird yesterday was 31 December and the characters were talking about Christmas was coming so that means their time is back in that means you’re not connected with our time so maybe in the next game they created can try to make Time related to ours.

reviews.title: Decade Player
reviews.text: I have literally played this game on and off since I was in the third grade. It was one of the first games I ever downloaded on my iPhone 3! It’s addictive in ways I cannot explain, but my favorite part is you can play it everyday or lose track for months and come back like nothings different. I love almost all of NimbleBits games! They really make them enjoyable and up to date without changing the entire game experience. I most definitely recommend you play if you’re intrigued.

reviews.title: Never change!
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this on and off since I was a freshman in high school, and I just graduated college recently. My favorite thing about this app is the small, useful updates without completely transforming the app into something else entirely. This app is still true to its original form, it’s just been modified in subtle and helpful ways. I love that I’m not being bombarded by ads, I love how you can empty the piggy, what a fun feature. I just really love how much this app has retained its integrity while only ever improving. Fantastic game, keep it up!

reviews.title: Love game but……
reviews.text: I love this game. It’s fun. Been playing with it for a long time now. What I don’t like is you can’t uninstall and reinstall if there are issues. You’ll start from scratch again. Not cool. I have not been able to get in app since last update. Why? Idk. Please fix the last update issues so I can get in app. It won’t go past game name. App crashes immediately. Then I can update my review because I really enjoy the game thank you in advance ❤️

reviews.title: so addictive!!
reviews.text: i won't stop picking up my phone to check tiny tower! there's something so magical and aesthetically pleasing about restocking floors, changing bitzens outfits, etc. that i can't get enough of! i am definitely addicted to this game and it just makes it THAT more fun to add your friends and visit their tiny tower to see what they've built. the bitbook is so clever and a silly way to explore the minds of your bitzens. i am very impressed with the creation of this game with the use of pixels. there is always something you can do in tiny tower and i've yet to get bored!!

reviews.title: Great Game. Love The Concept.
reviews.text: A simpler but well done, quality game. The graphics are good, and there are lots of customization options to really personalize your tower. You have full control of the tower too, which I like very much. The characters almost seem real. Overall a pretty cool game. You could sit and play for hours or you could just use it as a time passer. You don’t have to spend any real money to play or make progress. The currency is easy to come by, they practically throw it at you. I would definitely recommend this to just about anybody.

reviews.title: All Time Great Mobile Game
reviews.text: Over the past decade or so, mobile gaming has largely shifted away from genuinely fun small games towards free to play apps riddled with nonstop ads and microtransactions. Tiny Tower is one of the few games where you can sit back and genuinely enjoy the experience. Sure, there are ads, but all of them are optional and watching them rewards you with coins. It’s a great game, and arguably one of my favorite mobile games of all time. Nimblebit is a great developer for sure, 10/10 would recommend

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text:
Hello you are probably thinking fun? What do you mean fun? Isn’t that a bit of a short answer? No it’s the perfect title this game is amazing you can build a great amount of floors and you can use BitBook and laugh at the jokes all the bitizens say. Also you can get Bux which can be used for so much things as well as getting businesses up and naming them some funny names that make you laugh whenever you play. One question for the developers is...
Could you guys make little mini games in Tiny Tower in which you could get Bucks and Coins from? Thanks!

reviews.title: Excellent game, great to play as much or as little as you want
reviews.text: I love this game! The economy is varied with coins, bux, and gold tickets, with multiple ways to increase each. It’s great for passing time! I really appreciate how (before I bought the VIP version) you never had to watch ads and you could still get the full experience of the game without watching ads. Love the friend network and the hourly raffle for gold tickets (although my husband has played less than I have and has won the raffle three times more often than I have!).

reviews.title: Take the time to read this review!
reviews.text:
You know what i love about tiny tower? The devs. Dont get me wrong the game itself is also awesome, download it. 
But the devs are some of those very few who are NOT GREEDY. You can just as easily get the same benifits as someone who might make in app purchases by simply playing. And being a little more patient. You can do everything everyone else can and your not forced to pay to progress which is something we really dont see often these days.. so cheers to you devs, its a great game and a fair game for everyone.

reviews.title: Suggestion: Playing for years
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing tiny tower for years and love it so much! It’s the only app that has never left my device. I especially love how unobtrusive ads are - they’re incorporated into gameplay, are completely optional, reward the user for watching, and don’t disrupt the fun! 
It would be nice to have some sort of catalog or index letting us know the remaining floor options we have. As a longtime player, I want to know when to stop before I’m stuck with blank floors 🥲

reviews.title: Love it, but what if…
reviews.text:
I love this game! Best pastime game I’ve played ever, I am curious tho - what if there were a couple added updates like these:
- Tenant “appreciation” or host “likability” meter, like something that shows how well you take care of tenants (maybe evictions have some kind of effect, not taking care of tasks in a timely manner, not getting people to the right place, etc.)
- Replies to comments on BitBook, like AI generated or something, that shows what you can do to boost your likability (creating monuments, fully stocking floors, etc.)

reviews.title: Love this game
reviews.text: I started playing this game on my iPod in middle school and ever since on every device possible I’ve gotten Tiny Tower. Even though I have to restart every time, it’s worth it!! Interesting floor options, customizable NPCs (and i mean completely- from hair to tie color), and plenty of chances to watch ads for free in game currency. It’s playable without the ads, but it definitely helps, and there are no ads unless you choose to watch them. I would recommend to all people of all ages!!

reviews.title: Consistently amazing game! The go-to!
reviews.text:
